title: Artie Shaw and the McCarthy blacklisting
summary: Shaw lost bookings after being branded a communist and offered $10,000 to anyone who could prove it.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Politics, race and the state of the country

blocks.x: Joe McCarthy branded him a communist, and consequently a lot of his bookings were cancelled on account of that. But this Joe McCarthy -- that was a vicious thing because Artie was not a communist, you know. They also had Hazel Scott (Larry), Luther Adler, the harmonica player. Oh, just -- this Joe McCarthy ruined quite a few careers at this -- you know. But I --
Was Artie called before the comm. hear?
Yes, and Artie told them he would pay anyone $10,000.00 who could prove that he was a communist.
